title: Unit Event — On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint
meta.Outline: As N25's music evolves, Ena struggles to capture the true essence of their songs in her art. In the interest of keeping up with the group, she considers going back to her old art class...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It doesn't go with Kanade and Mafuyu's song at all.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I think I chose too many bright colors.
Time to start over...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I feel like I've been telling myself that I'm wrong a lot lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This might've started after Mafuyu learned how to write different lyrics compared to usual.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What is this...?
I've definitely felt this before...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, it's time already?
And... Unmute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, can I say something before we do...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It's about my rough draft for our next song.
I'm kinda stuck. Mind taking a look at it for me?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Me too.
Can you send it through Nightcord?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You've captured the theme for this song and the colors seem right...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, it seems blurry for some reason...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... I think I know what you mean. It's like you're lost or not sure what to do, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It matches what K's envisioning with her song, but...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's as if you want to speak out, but don't know how...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is this really everything you're trying to say?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is she talking about what I felt after hearing Kanade's song and seeing her lyrics...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If that's the case, she's right. I haven't been able to express that at all...)
Shinonome, as it stands, your current mindset will only hinder you from growing further as an artist.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<We still have time.
Let's keep thinking about it together.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll try coming up with a better storyboard too!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's the same thing I felt back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Between Mafuyu's lyrics and Kanade's music, it's like everyone's finding new ways to express what they're feeling... While I get left behind...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I actually do get left behind...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I can't figure out a way to illustrate our group's music...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I don't want that to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to keep drawing. I have to find a way...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Composition, colors, technique...
I have to study more and figure out how to turn our group's music into art.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I know it's easier said than done.
Because I spent so much time in that place...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There's no place in visual art for those who decide not to show up for two years...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (A pretty good drawing if I do say so myself. Mr. Yukihira won't have any choice but to praise me today.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Time's up. Bring your drawings forward and I'll begin reviewing your work.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Let's start from that end.
Whose is this?

I-It's mine!
What do you think, Mr. Yukihira?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Ah, Futaba Natsuno.
Yes... It's rather appalling.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: It's as if you forgot that a third dimension exists. What were you looking at all this time?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: It's the most fundamental part of drawing sculptures. If you were looking for depth, you should've focused on...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(As grouchy as ever, huh...?
Everyone's gone completely quiet too.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (But that's not going to be enough to discourage me.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Ah, Shinonome.
Let's take a look.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
This composition isn't bad...
Your motif here appears well presented.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(H-He praised me...!
Mr. Yukihira actually praised me...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
However, you get a zero for texture.
If anything, this looks more like a bronze statue.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Focus on making better use of intermediate tones and value more next time. Anyway, who's next...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough for today.
Good work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... Work on using intermediate tones...?! Does he not realize I've been coming here for five years now...?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Dad did say that Mr. Yukihira's a pretty strict teacher, but it's almost as if he hates praising people...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(He has won a bunch of big awards though...
Plus, a lot of his students are trying to get into Tokyo Art University, so it is a pretty high-level class.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (But that sourpuss of a teacher actually praised me for once. He said, “This composition isn't bad.” He never tells anyone else that.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (I guess it's no wonder since I'm gonna be a famous artist just like my dad...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
You'll be drawing flowers today.
Do not forget about depth and texture as you work...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: This won't do. The colors you've chosen for this motif aren't doing their job. It's as if your small brush strokes are making everything blend together into a single substance.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: So it's better to lay down colors in a way that makes each of them stand out...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Start over. See, feel and draw.
Sense it with your entire body.

Wow...! Ena, yours is so amazing...!
I can learn a lot from the way you used values.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't it?
How does yours look, Futaba?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Nowhere near as good as yours.
We started attending this class at the same time, but you've made so much more progress than me...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I wouldn't worry about that too much.
Yeah, you need to have talent to draw, but you still have to work hard to actually see improvement.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Speaking of which, entrance exams are coming up. Do you know where you want to go, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Yup! I'm gonna go to a high school that'll really let me focus on my art.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I still haven't picked where, but I'm planning on asking my dad more about that.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
That's right, you can ask him directly...
I should start thinking about those things too if I'm going to take art seriously.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd also recommend that.
You only live once, so you should go through life doing what you love.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I want to go to a school with a fine arts program but can't decide between these two. They both sound really great but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I want to be an artist so...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I thought I should learn as much as I can right now...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you saying?!
You're joking, right?
That's not funny, you know?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I'm not joking.
You don't have any talent.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: But there's no way that's true. I've been drawing since I was little and even got special prizes in middle school for my art...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Yes, I know. But there are countless others hoping to do the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Unless you can win the grand prize at a big contest, then no one will recognize you.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Why are you saying this now?
You never did until this point.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I'm serious about this, but you just...!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You won't be able to become the kind of artist you're envisioning.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: If you had talent with the resolve to match, then things may be different...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Was everything I did until now just a complete waste of time?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I don't have any talent, so it doesn't matter how hard I work?!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Yes...
The world I live in works just as you say.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: No doors will open for you as you are now.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You have no right to decide that...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: It's my future, so stay out of it!!

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
That's strange...
Where's Ena? It's almost time for class. Did something happen to her...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(No, that's not possible.
I've been drawing for as long as I can remember... Mr. Yukihira even praised my drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Starting today, we'll have some students visiting our class, so please join me in welcoming them.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (I have talent... I know I do...!)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I'll start looking at what you've drawn.
Starting with this one.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(I feel like this one turned out well...
I'm sure Mr. Yukihira will...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Ah, a trail through a forest.
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
My eyes are confused...
The viewer's eyes aren't being drawn towards the trees in the back as they should.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: B-But you praised my composition last time... I made sure to include the same nuances from that drawing in this one!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: On top of that, I feel like this is drawn better overall...!

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: That was then, this is now. You're comparing apples to oranges. Unless you learn to understand that, your layout process will continue to suffer.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You're patting yourself on the back after receiving one positive comment. You should instead be finding other ways to improve your drawing techniques, no?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Yes, I see. I have no other choice but to be more direct with you.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Shinonome, you're blowing your own skills out of proportion.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: If praise is all that you seek, then there is no point in you coming to this class.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Shinonome, as it stands, your current mindset will only hinder you from growing further as an artist.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (No... What is this...? Why's everyone so quiet...?)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The point of focus for this is too ambiguous. You may benefit from drawing in a way that allows the viewer to see the entire picture even when they're squinting. However...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Overall, this is drawn rather well.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(He praised them...?
Why? He never praises anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Is it because other students are visiting...?)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Well done...
You've done a marvelous job illustrating how the apple warps when seen through glass.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You even improved upon your use of depth as I mentioned last time. This piece has much more breadth to it.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (That last piece, and Futaba's... They're so good... The way they're designed, their use of color... They're so much better than me...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: For our final free theme, you'll be drawing... “Yourselves.” Please draw using whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (I'm the daughter of an artist... I've been drawing for as long as I can remember and others have always praised my work...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Shinonome, as it stands, your current mindset will only hinder you from growing further as an artist.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Let's start looking at what you've drawn.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(Was Futaba always this good...?
Her drawing feels so powerful and alive...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (When did she learn to draw like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
(No, it's me... I just wasn't looking...
It's not just Futaba either. It's as if everybody here is...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: First... Ah, Shinonome, this must be yours.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Even if you say that I don't have any talent... That I shouldn't bother... I...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have nothing to say to you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Sorry, I think I spaced out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That was the last time I went to that class...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mom got so mad at me after she found out that I quit without really saying anything.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have nothing to say to you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I'm not his student anymore.
Anyway, that reference book should be around here somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is...
How long's it been? I remember going through this so many times in the past.

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: “You're always welcome to join us, Shinonome.”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right. I was sent this after I quit.
But only this one notice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The way I quit kinda made me want to never go back again...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (His spring workshop... It's already that time of year, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I might be able to find a way to get better if I go back...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Despite everything I've said about him, Mr. Yukihira's a great teacher. I mean, many of his students got into Tokyo Art University...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Everyone else will have improved leaps and bounds by now. So much so that I'd stick out like a sore thumb...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After I quit, everyone started giving me these looks...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Ugh... Just thinking about it makes me sick...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I know I should go...
I stand to learn so much...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it'd make me seem so desperate...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need to wrap up my rough draft soon... I've made the others wait long enough as it is...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if I try doing that now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, this isn't it...
It's like I'm getting further and further away from the image in my head...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
I can't figure out what to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, we've been through this before. You sound really unhappy, so I'm worried that something bad happened to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<But...
If you're not up to it, you don't have to tell me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Especially since you're doing the same for me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At the same time, I'm sure you'll feel better if you talk about it, so just let me know when you feel you're ready!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I said that I'd wait and be there to listen. It wouldn't make sense for me to clam up and not reciprocate that.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, you think you're not good enough...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. At least, that's what I've been feeling lately.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K and Yuki keep finding new ways to express what they're feeling, while I'm having trouble keeping up with them...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At this rate, I feel like I'm not going to be able to properly illustrate their music...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <A part of me is even saying that I should relearn everything from scratch...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hmm...
I think you're being way too hard on yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <All of us, including me, really like what you draw, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks...
But I don't want to drag N25 down in any way. I want to do everything I can to prevent that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Which is how I ended up reminiscing about this art class I used to attend...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's run by this really amazing teacher, so I can still probably learn a lot by going... But I'm not sure I ever liked being there.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <On top of that, I'd only get shown up by everyone else there since I stopped going for two years...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And yet, I don't want things to continue like this...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Getting yourself to face the issue is never easy, isn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Just thinking about it makes your head hurt and want to give up.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Haha. Yeah, that.
It saps all your energy and you end up having to take so many breaks just to keep going...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, I can't believe you used to attend an actual art class...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. Sorry, I have a hard time imagining you learning to draw while sitting in class, you know? How long were you there?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I started when I was in second grade and quit during my third year of junior high. I used to go every week too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The teacher's a friend of my dad, and I was invited to join his class after being blown away by one of his pieces at this exhibit he held...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? So you learned to draw and paint from your dad's friend?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, but his class was always so tense since he sort of doesn't hold back when reviewing our work.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I started by learning how to sketch, then moved on to watercolor and oil painting. Oh, I learned to use clay a little too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's to get a better grasp of all three dimensions. Some students even went on to learn how to do sculptures and reliefs because of that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, that sounds fun!
I wanna give that a try too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What kind of stuff did you draw back then, Enanan? Anything similar to what you're drawing for N25?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What did I draw back then...?
A lot of different things. I can't really reduce it down to one genre or anything...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I also used to draw inspiration from some songs I heard even before I was aware of K or her music.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Whenever I sat down to really think about what a song's talking about, I always felt that I could produce something really good...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I totally get what you mean.
I usually do the same thing when I'm making music videos for N25.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's like N25's become a good creative output for us...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, I also remember putting together a scrapbook of “all my favorite things”...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, I've made one before too!
Cutting out stuff from my favorite magazines and movie flyers was so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What did you do for yours, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Me? Um...
I had flyers from these art exhibits I really liked and tried drawing some buildings that looked interesting...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Magazines too.
Oh, I even tried drawing some of the cover art that caught my eye from Akito's CDs...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Cosmetics too. I still remember being really irked by how my teacher said, “Very typical of you, Shinonome.” It's not like I ever put on that much makeup...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I kinda get what he meant by that.
Anyway, what did you guys do after you made your scrapbooks?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Those were just ways of examining our personalities as opposed to a preamble for anything else. Wait, you've gotta hear what my teacher said about what I drew after that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry! It's just... You sound like you're having fun talking about all this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. You said that you weren't sure you ever liked going there, but you got to do all these things that you'd never get to do in school.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess there were some fun moments along the way.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Earth to Enanan! You there? Why'd you clam up all of a sudden?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
It's like I'm not bothered by what I experienced back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I haven't touched clay, my scrapbook or done any real sketches in so long... I don't want to feel that pain again, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't mention it. That's what friends are for, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Only three hours left to register for the spring workshop...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There should be a phone number somewhere on that postcard...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This is awful. My heart won't stop pounding because I'm so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes, this is Ena Shinonome...
It's been quite a while...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I, uhh...! Remember how she said she was having trouble with her rough draft?! I was worried, so um... How's it going...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<About that...
I'm sorry but I'm gonna need a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm thinking about relearning how to draw.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. There's this art class I used to attend and am thinking about going back...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In my current state, I feel like I won't be able to draw anything decent for this song or anything that comes after it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I promise to finish this draft and not do anything that holds the rest of you back.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Um, I mean... I'm okay with you going... What about you, K, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If Enanan believes she needs to do this, then I'm okay with it too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't mind if it's going to help our music...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You could phrase that a little better, Yuki, but thanks, you guys...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I promise to learn how to really illustrate the song you two wrote, K, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I thought I was ready for this...
But my feet feel like bricks...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(The class is right there...
And yet, it feels so far away.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder if everyone from back then is still there...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They've probably gotten better and better during these past two years...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Wow...! Ena, yours is so amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
I knew it was you, Ena.
Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Oh... That bag's for art supplies, right? Does this mean you registered for the spring workshop too?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Really?!
I'm so happy! I can't believe you came back...!

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Oh, let's go in together.
You have to go in a different way now, so I can show you where.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Over here, Ena! It's this way!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, here it is...
Next to that big building... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The entrance... Did one of the students draw this piece...? They're hanging up their art here now?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(They're all so good...
It's like each one is trying to suck me into its world...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She's gotten this good...?
This one too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's them... Everyone I attended class with back then drew these...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They improved this much in just two years...?)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Class is this way. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It still smells like paint...
All those memories are flooding back.)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Ena, the chairs and easels are here.
We can sit... There's a lot of people, so how about here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm really here...
I've come this far, so there's no turning back.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I only recognize about half of the people here. The rest must be visiting from elsewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
And welcome to our visiting students. My name is Saneatsu Yukihira. I will be your teacher.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: It's nice to see some familiar faces here again...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: This workshop will last for three days. You will not only be working on your foundational principles, we will also be having deep discussions regarding your work. I hope you're all ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Day one involves drawing sketches, day two is oil painting and we'll be given a theme to draw as we wish on day three...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sketches used to be my forte... But now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I have to do this...
So I can keep drawing for N25...!)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You're too conscious of your light source here, so it's too detailed. It should be more like this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We're drawing flowers and sculptures today. Their textures are completely different, so I have to find a way to make them look distinct from one another...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This looks all wrong...
Is it because I haven't drawn any sculptures in so long?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is my light source in the wrong place?
Is that why my drawing looks like it has no depth...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What am I supposed to do...?
I know I need to look more carefully when I'm doing this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, Futaba...
My pencil rolled your way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She's so focused...
She probably didn't even hear me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, it just means she's that serious about this. I should pick my pencil back up and...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Her sketch looks so real. No one ever goes this far. Her shadowing's so detailed too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The way she used intermediate tones almost looks professional...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I have to keep drawing...
My sketch isn't anywhere near done.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Just keep drawing... Just keep drawing... That's all I can do right now. I knew that I'd be the worst one before I came here...!)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Alright, time's up.
Let's begin reviewing your work.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
We'll start with this one.
Whose is this?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Overall, it looks slanted, and the jawline appears bent. Is this really the sculpture you saw, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Your use of shadow needs work as well. It's as if you've forgotten all your basic principles.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Next.
Ah, Natsuno, this must be yours.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I have nothing to say...
If anything, it's rather ordinary. I suggest you put more effort into composition next time.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I will. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah, Futaba's sketches have always been amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's improved so much since then too. She probably had to draw so much to get this far...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I knew this would happen too.
I had it all coming.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I ran away while she and everyone else kept at it these past two years...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Is something the matter, Ena?
You don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine...
Sorry, I'm gonna head home now.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Um, can we head out together?
I just need a second to pack everything up.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: How was your first class after all this time, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Nothing's changed...? Do you mean the class itself...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, like how tense it is in there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not only that, I still can't draw to save my life. Mr. Yukihira gave me his two cents as usual too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Why did I run away that time...?
Would I have gotten better like the others if I stayed...?)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Tense...? I think I understand.
Mr. Yukihira's as harsh a critic as ever.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I still sort of can't believe you've been going all this time, Futaba...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What have you been up to since I left?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Oh, um... I joined the art club at my high school and started coming here every day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Every day?
What happened to once or twice a week?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: The thing is... I want to go to Tokyo Art University.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?!
You mean THE Tokyo Art University?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Yes, but I wasn't sure if once or twice a week would be enough to get in since it's the most competitive art school in Japan. That's why I asked my mom if I could start coming here every day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Futaba's serious about art.
Unlike a certain someone who ran away from it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No wonder her sketch was so good...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Um, Ena...
I've been meaning to tell you this for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
I really like the way you draw.
So, I'm really glad that you came back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What's there to possibly like...?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I've always been drawn to the way your art has this strange uniqueness to it.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: It's almost as if you're seeing a different world, and able to express yourself in ways that the rest of us can't...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I've actually tried copying you a few times in the past, but I was never able to capture your style.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, Futaba, let me ask you this...
What did you think of what I drew today?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: But that's not the whole story...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I was told to get home early today...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Ena.
How was art class? I know it's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Same old, same old.
I'll be in my room until dinner...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I said I'd be going to that art class again starting today, so maybe I should let everyone in N25 know...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if any of them ask, “How was it?”)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <I've had a long day, so I'm gonna work offline for now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Copy that!
Don't work too hard, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line:
<Please rest when you feel better.
You don't have to worry about us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I still have that rough draft to finish.
I haven't even touched it for a few days now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But...
What am I supposed to draw...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But there's no point in worrying.
I have to just keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Day two is oil painting...
I used to get praised for the way I chose colors when I was in junior high...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Good morning, Ena.
You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
It looks like we're doing landscapes.
Let's do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Your underpainting needs more work.
It looks very uneven right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That's it for my drawing...
But this doesn't look right at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The worst part is that I can't specifically say what's wrong. Is it the underpainting? The perspective?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I sort of want to scrap it and start all over now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, she's already doing touch-ups...
Her painting has so much presence to it...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
That will be all for today.
Good work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Day two and still no results.
Mr. Yukihira gave me his usual criticism too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I knew going into this that I can't make up for two years of not drawing seriously in just a few days...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'm pretty exhausted...
I'm gonna head home. Bye bye.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm home...
Oh, right. Mom's out today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like having some tea...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Hm? Is someone home...?
Mom's said she'd be gone so... Akito?)

Ena...
I didn't realize you were home.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: More importantly, how's your class going...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, why do you know about...?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Draw anything that satisfies you yet?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I don't have a choice, do I...?
Also, there's only one day left so...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I'm not talking about the spring workshop. I'm saying that you'll keep feeling this pain if you choose to continue drawing...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You won't always be able to produce works that satisfy you. Can you deal with that pain moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Can I deal with that pain...?
How am I supposed to know...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, I clearly don't belong in that class and felt completely embarrassed after getting lambasted in front of everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I've only gone two days...
And I already feel like puking...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to run away anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which means... I have to keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What did you think of this demo...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was light and uplifting...
I'm looking forward to seeing Mafuyu's lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, didn't you say that you haven't uploaded your last song yet because the video's missing the illustrations it needs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's why we decided to go forward with me making some new demos. This is one of those.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But is Ena going to be okay?
She hasn't worked on her illustration in quite some time, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's true, but we know she's doing her best to produce the right art for us. So for now, let's give her a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I sent her a message yesterday but haven't gotten a reply yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's probably still not happy with what she's drawn.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope it's not more than that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked before she went off to that art class, but she seemed really unsure about going. That kinda made me worried...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not sure if it's okay for me to say this right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I want to help Ena somehow if she is suffering because of all this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mind telling us more about what you two talked about, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (There's definitely a chance that she's gonna call me a worrywart or something for surprising her like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No...
This isn't it at all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
More colors...
No, this part needs to be darker...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh... It looks like a mess...
Now I have to redraw it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
She seems a little better now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing's working. I keep drawing and drawing, but it looks all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to get better to keep up with the rest of N25. I have to catch up to them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know that I have to keep drawing, but every time I do, I become so overwhelmed with pain that my mind goes blank...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Enanan, would it be possible for us to talk?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<They're all worried about you.
They want to help...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry for making you wait, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We didn't realize Rin was with you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
More importantly, I'm so sorry.
I keep getting stuck after promising to get this thing done...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We know that you're trying your best, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also... Sorry, but we had Mizuki tell us more about the art class you've been attending.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel awful for not realizing that you think you need to get better to catch up to us...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's not your fault, Kanade.
It's my fault for not being a better illustrator...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's like all that time I was gone has come back to haunt me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone else seems to know exactly how to draw what they want to draw...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: While I'm so far behind that I'm struggling to do even the most basic things...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My mind's telling me to just keep drawing and doing whatever I can to get better.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But my body can't handle it...
Every time I go, I start shaking because I'm so scared of going to that class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't do what the others can do and I know I'm never going to receive positive criticism. More than anything, I can't forgive myself for letting this all happen...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep asking myself, “Why did I run away that time...?”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I want to keep drawing...
I want to prevent being left behind by N25 at all costs...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At least, that's what my mind's telling me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think you were running away from anything, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It may be true that drawing illustrations for N25 won't necessarily give you opportunities to learn anything new or improve your skills.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But in my opinion, your art has improved compared to when we first met. It's clear that you're always looking for the best way to illustrate the music Mafuyu and I make.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've recently been catching myself thinking just how much I like what you draw, Ena. You have this way of conveying so many different feelings all at once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But feelings aren't enough.
Those alone won't get me anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At this rate, if I stop growing as an artist...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if you've grown as an artist...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I remember being confused by your old illustrations in terms of what you were trying to express because of how you used odd colors and bent lines.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? FYI, that was all on purpose...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But in retrospect...
I guess I could've done better to get my message across.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But now, things seem a little different.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still confused sometimes, but I understand your art better than before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know this is a lot to process...
But I don't want you to think that these past two years were a complete waste.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your illustrations have helped us so much. They've helped N25 so much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I found N25 and decided to give art another try.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After that... We met for the first time in SEKAI, I did terribly in that contest and became almost incurably depressed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I realized that I want to keep drawing for N25...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena, you gotta see this.
All of N25's videos!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, look. We're up to this many now because Kanade keeps churning out new songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry. I can't help myself since I'm still determined to compose a song that can save people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why are you apologizing?
I need you to keep composing for the foreseeable future.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, talk about a blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really like what you drew for some of our old stuff! It's kinda rough, but it gives it that sort of edge, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this one too!
Remember how you had some trouble coming up with ideas and we ended up making it together?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I redrew it so many times because I didn't know which motifs to go with and it took forever to finish.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This one...? We uploaded it just the other day, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. As much as I like your old illustrations, I like your recent ones more. Your weird choice of colors is like an expression of who you are, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that supposed to be a compliment?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know much about art...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But if you really felt like running away, I doubt you would've drawn all these things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know... No, I ran away for two years... That's just the cold, hard truth...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like trying a little bit more now...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
E-Ena!
Are you feeling better now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, sorry about yesterday...
But I'm fine now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Today's our last day, so let's make the most of it...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Right!
Let's give our free pieces everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone.
It looks like you're all here now.
Let's start by unveiling today's theme.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
You will each have six hours.
Your theme will be “yourselves”.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's that theme...
The one that made me run away...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Back then, I was so full of myself for being “the daughter of a famous artist”...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that's not who I am now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The current “me” is this pathetic creature that always has to look over its shoulder...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that's just who I am... So...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(My light source looks okay...
Everything's shadowed the way I imagined too. I can spend the rest of my time cleaning it up a bit.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Time's up.
We'll immediately start reviewing what you've drawn.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Let's start from the edge... I take it this is yours, Natsuno?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Yes!
I... I drew my own hand.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Her painting... It feels so warm.
It's gentle but straightforward...
Almost like a symbol of how much she loves art.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is this what Mafuyu means by that warmth she's been feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I see. As common as this motif and style of composition is, it's a good representation of who you are, Natsuno...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: It's literally a part of you. A very important part that you can't live without. Not only that, your delicate brushwork is quite astounding.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(He's right...
No tricks. It's just her and nothing else. It really is a great representation of who Futaba is...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Our last one is by... Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: This painting... Is this your back?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's me at night as I'm working away on my tablet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(These past two years...
I kept drawing without really facing my art.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I found a place of belonging in them...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I see...
I'll go down my list one by one.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: First, I do not understand the message you're trying to convey.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I cannot tell what this person's feeling is aside from having no real interest in facing their art. There seems to be no point of focus either.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You appear to have put quite a bit of effort into these shadows to illustrate that it's nighttime, but it has become too dark as a result. Ideas are important, but so is presentation.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(He's completely right...
Everything he said is correct.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(The current me can't do it...
I can't express the way I feel clearly.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But I stood my ground this time...
I took a hard look at myself and put pen to paper.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This is where it starts... This is my first step...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: All of you did some nice work these past three days. Any visiting students that want to keep attending...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It was so painful...
But I made it through the end...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?! M-Mr. Yukihira...?!
I-Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Thank you for attending all three days.
Mind if we talked about what you drew for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Let's start with your drawing from the first day. I've already told you about the bigger issues at hand, but it seems like your observational skills have diminished overall.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: As a result, you didn't notice how bent the jawline was on top of you using not enough values.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: But you have nothing to fear as long as you work on your basics. If possible, I'd like it if you could draw a piece every day.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Next, your oil painting from the second day. It was hard to look at because of its unevenness, so you may benefit from relearning how to actually use and mix oil paint.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: However, the composition was good in terms of how you framed it. If it weren't so unevenly painted, your focal point and motif would've both done their jobs properly.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Which is unfortunate since this also ties back into your observational skills leaving more to be desired...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This is awful. It's like pins and needles are coming out of his mouth, and going straight for my heart. At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: But I thought I did a really good job with this one...!

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: What you were trying to convey was very clear, Shinonome. However, that's only one part of the entire picture...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You need to be able to see things through a wider lens. In addition, you should work on your composition skills with a focus on choosing the right colors for the sake of the motifs you choose.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: But I was sure that my composition and choice of colors were both good...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: If praise is all that you seek, then I'll stop saying anything...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: However, that will only hinder your growth. As your teacher and fellow artist, I must keep pointing these things out to you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's right. He always set aside time after class to work with his students...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Your message remains unclear mostly due to your actual painting skills coupled with a lack of expressiveness.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I believe you stand to improve quite a bit if you can figure out what you want to convey while learning how to balance out your motifs and use of shadows.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: At the very least, your art now seems to be able to reel in the viewer by making them “wonder” what you're thinking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mr. Yukihira...
You remember what I drew last time?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Yes, you'd already left before I had a chance to discuss it with you. However, I made sure to write down what I said, so I'll hand that note to you before you leave today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: About what I drew today, Mr. Yukihira... What did you think?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I already told you that.
It was hard to look at because of your poor foundation.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: But it was clear that you were taking a hard look at your art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: D-Do you think I can get better...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I kept running away from art... I regret doing that, but I was so sure that it was too late for me... And yet...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I do not know how or if you will improve...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: But that door will remain open as long as you're willing to face your own art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
You'll always be welcome here.
Please, feel free to stop by again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The old me only went to that class expecting to be showered with praise.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The current me is so afraid of criticism that I desperately avoid being told anything negative...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: As your teacher and fellow artist, I must keep pointing these things out to you.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: At the very least, your art now seems to be able to reel in the viewer by making them “wonder” what you're thinking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If it's still possible for me to grow as an artist...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I don't care if there's zero chance. I don't care if that door closes on me...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm done running...
It won't be easy and it's gonna hurt... But I don't care how long it takes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I absolutely vow to become the artist that N25 really deserves...!)
